column2: Continue this shot seamlessly: a near-empty black screen with a tiny still line-drawn plane outline fades up into blank cream paper, the plane redrawn as a faint pale risograph ghost outline in the same place; quiet, minimal, almost still. No text, no new elements.

Continue this shot seamlessly, dreamlike Waking Life rotoscope: the grey-bearded man in a navy coat on the commuter train stays the same man as the carriage melts and flows into a golden-hour rooftop where he leans on the parapet; the old words fade away and new words drift in. Same man throughout, no other people.

Continue this shot seamlessly, dreamlike Waking Life rotoscope: the grey-bearded man in the armchair of a flying living room stays the same man as the room dissolves and re-forms into a diner booth where he sits; the old words fade away. Same man throughout, no other people.

Continue this shot seamlessly, dreamlike Waking Life rotoscope: inside a car at dusk the grey-bearded man juggling his own head lands it back as the car unfolds into an empty lot at dusk where he stands and begins to float, a soft single spiral cloud above. Same man throughout, no other people.

Continue this shot seamlessly: the grey-bearded man in a navy coat, drawn in hand-drawn rotoscope style, softens and redraws into a cute boxy kawaii character with a kaomoji face, grey beard and navy coat, floating up into a pastel watercolour dusk sky with little clouds; wobbly marker lines and watercolour wash.

Continue this shot seamlessly: the cute kawaii night plane cabin with the sleeping character and the oval window contracts and darkens into a glowing black-box recorder playback screen, orange waveforms and interface lines on black, the window becoming the monitor.
